prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-97828
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-97828 for $4,323.37 USDC. We wanted to ensure it hasn’t slipped through the cracks on your end.

If you haven’t had a chance to process this payment yet, you can send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xa9456eae133d4cb0fb48316b477b9448d22f353e. Please include the invoice number in the memo field so our accounts team can match the transaction quickly.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please ignore this note! If you have any questions about the line items or need a copy of the original invoice re-sent, just reply to this email and we’ll help you out. Thanks for your continued partnership with Yarrow Print.

Best regards,

Billing Team
Yarrow Print
